say:1:1533103001:1.text: Hmph! At least you have some sense...

say:2:1533103002:1.text: Alright, my set menu comes in three courses: an appetizer, a main course, and a dessert at the end. Pick what you want.

say:6:1533103005:1.text: Tender, sweet berries, bursting with juice... just the treat you've been yearning for.

say:12:1533103013:1.text: A sweet-but-not-too-sweet ice cream cake. Pop some in your mouth for a refreshing, guilt-free treat!
say:12:1533103013:1.source_cn: 甜而不腻的冰糕，赶路时吃一块，清爽无负担。

say:15:1533103014:1.text: Nothing beats sipping straight from a coconut while strolling along the beach.

say:16:1533103015:1.text: Another raw dish?! Alright, don't be wasteful now. Whatever has been ordered needs to be eaten.
say:16:1533103015:1.source_cn: 怎么又是生的？！记住……浪费可耻，点了菜就必须全都吃完。

say:17:1533103010:1.text: Barbecue and meat are a must.

say:18:1533103011:1.text: You'd never pick something so disgusting-sounding on purpose, but something this mysteriously dreadful? Well, now you're curious!
